title: Site-local waveform sampling semantics
reason: The original Phase-3 implementation imposed cross-site equality of raw active-sample counts. Canonical PWDB waveforms have valid site-local active supports that can differ across anatomical sites, while pointwise U/A support is aligned locally for Q=U*A.

immutable_primary_semantics.population: 4374 PWDB states; six ages; 729 states per age
immutable_primary_semantics.canonical_tie_break: smallest global target row index within min distance + 1e-6

amended_source_semantics.ordinary_waveform: validate and phase-resample each waveform on its own active source support
amended_source_semantics.reconstructed_flow: compute Q=U*A on local source samples before phase resampling
amended_source_semantics.flow_required_alignment: U and A local sample support must be identical; no Radial-count equality
forbidden_repairs: truncate secondary waveforms to Radial length
pad secondary waveforms to Radial length
force raw secondary samples onto the Radial raw grid
derive a new duration from each secondary site

new_execution_gates.waveform_preflight: audit all 52 common-site members; cross-site count differences recorded and permitted; local U/A equality required
new_execution_gates.P0_reproducibility_gate: before any P1/P2/downstream endpoint, verify the preserved original P0 artifacts and reproduce them exactly/within the locked numerical contract
new_execution_gates.failure_evidence: write structured execution_failure.json with stage and files present on any exception
